name: Drive Reads & Shooting
summary: Warm up your handle, read the low man on drives, punish closeouts with an up-fake jumper, then finish tired off a backpedal sprint.

drills.name: In-and-Out Dribble Series
drills.summary: Wake up your hands with the in-and-out move, standing still and then on the move.
steps: Stand in a low stance, ball in your right hand.
Push the ball across your body, then snap it back out with the same hand. Do 30 seconds.
Switch to your left hand for 30 seconds.
Walk forward doing in-and-outs, switching hands at each line.
Last minute: in-and-out, then explode two hard dribbles forward.

drills.name: Low Man Drive Reads
drills.summary: Drive the lane and read the help defender: finish if he stays home, kick it out if he steps up.
steps: Put one cone in the corner and one on the wing. Your partner stands on the block as the low man.
Start at the top and drive hard to the rim.
Your partner either steps up into the lane or stays on the block.
If they step up, kick it out to the open cone spot. If they stay, finish at the rim.
Partner grabs the kick-out and resets. Switch roles at 2 minutes.

drills.name: Up-Fake Side Dribble Jumpers
drills.summary: Sell the shot, side-step one dribble, and knock down the jumper.
steps: Start at the right wing, just inside the three-point line.
Catch in triple threat and show a hard shot fake.
Take one dribble to the side and square your feet to the rim.
Rise and shoot. Get your rebound and go to the next spot.
Rotate wing, elbow, top, other elbow, other wing.

drills.name: Backpedal Sprint Finishes
drills.summary: Backpedal to half court, then sprint back and finish strong while tired.
steps: Start under the basket holding the ball.
Backpedal to half court with the ball in your hands.
Turn and speed dribble back to the rim.
Finish with a layup, alternating right and left hands each rep.
Rebound, step back under the rim, and go again. Rest only on the walk back.
